[[Plague Worm]]s behave very similarly to other [[Worm]]s in the game, except they will by default not attack and are unable to move.

==Locations==
*[[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
**{{NPC location|Lakeside County}} - level 0, in the field directly north east of [[Ashford Abbey]] (before [[The Worm Problem]])
**{{NPC location|Regent Valley (pre-Searing)}} - level 1 (during [[A Test of Marksmanship]])

==Items dropped==
*[[Baked Husk]]

==Notes==
*Based on their attack range, they most likely wield [[shortbow]]s.
*Although they spit from their maws to shoot, they actually fire normal arrows.
*If hit with a physical attack as they descend into the ground, the attack will not appear to hit, but the worm will pop up about a second later and will appear to have taken the damage (including damage dealt by [[Ignite Arrows]]).
*If you kill them right before they go into the ground they may drop something but they will not leave a [[corpse]].
*Level 0 Plague Worms have 50 [[health]], level 1 Plague Worms have 80 health and take heavy damage from [[piercing damage]].
